description: Autonomous Peano Sovereignty Layer axiom set for PR #39. Extends Peano Arithmetic with explicit sovereignty invariants: determinism, cross-machine reproducibility, and formal Merkle anchoring. Immutable once frozen under invariant_spec_version=v2.

axioms.name: Zero (Sovereignty)
axioms.statement: 0 is the unique sovereign origin of every natural number chain. No computation may redefine zero.

axioms.name: Successor (Determinism)
axioms.statement: For every natural number n, S(n) is uniquely determined. Successor is a pure, deterministic function with no side effects.

axioms.name: Zero not successor
axioms.statement: For no natural number n is S(n) = 0. The sovereign origin has no predecessor within the natural numbers.

axioms.name: Successor injective
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers m, n: if S(m) = S(n) then m = n. Two distinct numbers cannot converge to the same successor.

axioms.name: Induction (Sovereignty Closure)
axioms.statement: If a sovereignty invariant holds for 0, and whenever it holds for n it also holds for S(n), then it holds for all natural numbers. No exception may be carved out.

axioms.name: Addition base
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers n, n + 0 = n. Zero is the additive identity across all sovereign nodes.

axioms.name: Addition step
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers m, n: m + S(n) = S(m + n). Addition is fully reducible to successor application.

axioms.name: Multiplication base
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers n, n * 0 = 0.

axioms.name: Multiplication step
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers m, n: m * S(n) = (m * n) + m.

axioms.name: Cross-machine reproducibility
axioms.statement: Every arithmetic computation expressible in terms of PS1-PS9 must produce a bit-identical result on any conforming node, regardless of OS, CPU architecture, or Python version.

axioms.name: Merkle anchoring
axioms.statement: The canonical hash of this axiom set and all derived spec files must be anchored in the invariant_spec_v2.freeze file. Any deviation in the freeze file invalidates all proof bundles referencing it.

axioms.name: Hash determinism seed
axioms.statement: All hashing operations in the Peano Sovereignty Layer must be performed with PYTHONHASHSEED=39 to ensure cross-run reproducibility.
